rules.then: enforce 100 requests per minute per user

sections.name: Policy Update (October 2025)
sections.note: Post-incident review INC-2025-0947: session hijacking via long-lived session token.

patches.updated_then: set session TTL to 4 hours — reduced from 24h after INC-2025-0947
require two-factor authentication via hardware security key (FIDO2) — TOTP deprecated

sections.name: Policy Revocation (January 2026)
sections.note: API rate limit removed after migration to token-bucket algorithm with per-endpoint limits.

revocations.reason: Replaced by per-endpoint rate limits in API gateway — blanket per-user limit no longer applicable
